items.statement: Q3 FY25 operating cash flow was INR218 crores, significantly higher than previous periods
items.quote: In fact, if I look at the current quarter, we did create cash flow from operations to the tune of INR218 crores. And so that was like significantly high than what it has been in the previous period.

items.statement: First 9 months FY25 operating cash flow was INR560 crores, helping reduce debt despite weak P&L
items.quote: When I think through the entire 9 months cash flow, in fact, has done very well. We have got cash from operations to the tune of INR560 crores and which has helped us to an extent reduce the debt as well despite the weak P&L performance.

items.statement: Receivables reduced by INR120 crores in Q3 FY25, with another INR150 crores+ reduction expected in Q4 FY25
items.quote: So again, overall receivable as I said have come down and actually INR120 crores receivables have come down in this third quarter. And they come from various things, but fourth quarter we are expecting another reduction of at least, I would say INR150 crores plus on net basis

items.statement: Net receivables down INR200 crores over last 12 months, targeting majority of old receivables recovery by September 2025
items.quote: Overall, if you see in our -- over the last 1 year, receivables on a net basis are down by INR200 crores overall. And as I said, I think going forward, this quarter, June quarter, September quarter, you will see even more substantial reduction.

items.statement: No current plan to sell Rivulis stake; will consider when timing and valuation are right
items.quote: In terms of selling Rivulis stake we got into that March '23 in terms of getting that done. So it has been 1.5 years. We have some understanding right that business has to grow for us to get a right amount of value, etcetera. So that is not something we are looking at that right now. But as and when timing is right, valuation is right, we may look at that opportunity as well.

items.statement: Cash reserves of Rs.342 crores as of December 31, 2024
items.quote: As of December 31, 2024, our cash reserves stood at Rs.342 crores.

items.statement: NCRPS redemption of Rs.107 crores including 20% premium due January 2026
items.quote: the redemption is coming in the next January, January '26. And the outflow would be around Rs.107 crores, which is already provided for.

items.statement: NCRPS redemption includes 20% premium
items.quote: It is including premium, 20% redemption premium is included in Rs.107 crores.

items.statement: Management may raise more funds via preferential issue or warrants as and when required.
items.quote: See, all of this is very dynamic. It all depends on what opportunities come in. So, yes, we may be raising more funds, but as and when required.

items.statement: Working capital days reduced from 36 to 33 days, target is 30 days
items.quote: if you look at the number of days of working capital despite the last year, we started at about 36 days, which has come down to around 33. Our target is to bring it down to 30, number one.

items.statement: Promoters subscribed to rights issue beyond their quota, then sold some shares for personal needs; net holding increased.
items.quote: Between October to December, we have a right too where promoter has subscribed more than their quota, okay?

items.statement: Promoters infused more money than they sold; further selling not expected.
items.quote: But then there was some, but at the same time if you see, promoter have infused the more money than they sold off, correct?

items.statement: Net cash balance after loans is INR 8 crore plus liquid investments.
items.quote: Cash balance right now if I go by my cash flow , statutory cash flow, net-net after loan and everything INR 8 crore is there already there apart from the some liquid investment and all this one.

items.statement: Implemented automated debtor control system blocking accounts exceeding credit period to improve collections.
items.quote: we have implemented in our company the system for better outstanding control, which is what I mean by now there will be no manual intervention . If any debtor is going beyond the credit period approved as per the contract, his or her account will get blocked, and only after getting the money or after the very senior management intervention, this account will get unblocked.

items.statement: Consolidated cash at end of Q3 FY25 was ₹917 million and net cash was ₹259 million after outstanding debt.
items.quote: The consolidated cash at the end of the quarter was ₹917 million, and the net cash was ₹259 million after considering outstanding debt.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA declined from Rs. 20 crores to Rs. 18 crores year-on-year.
items.quote: From an operating EBITDA perspective, we are more or less, similar or just about 10 % behind where we were same time last year, from Rs. 20 crores to about Rs. 18 crores.

items.statement: Preferential issue proceeds used to buy second falling weight deflectometer and second mobile bridge inspection unit
items.quote: our preferential money proceeds have been used to purchase two major equipment. One is the falling weight deflectometer which is the second one now and a mobile bridge inspection unit is also a second one.

items.statement: Company gives ESOPs to employees as talent acquisition edge
items.quote: We are giving ESOPs to our employees. So, we have an edge over our competitors when it comes to talent acquisition.

items.statement: Secured sanctions of close to ₹81 crores and drawn down approximately ₹27.5 crores so far
items.quote: We have successfully secured sanctions worth close to ₹81 crores, of which we have drawn down approximately ₹27.5 crores so far.

items.statement: Internal auditor function transferred to new hire Saurabh; Viral Sheth remains Finance Controller
items.quote: It is just that there was too much on his table, and we had a new hire in internal audit function. So, Saurabh will take care from here.

items.statement: Collection efficiency current and up to 30 DPD improved to 97.3% in December 2024 from 96.5% in September 2024
items.quote: During the quarter, our overall collection efficiencies, this is current and up to 30 DPD improved to 97.3% in December '24, up from 96.5% in September '24

items.statement: Collection efficiency current and up to 90 DPD rose to 95.2% in December 2024 from 94.5% in September 2024
items.quote: while the collection efficiencies in the current and up to 90 DPD rose to 95.2% in December '24 compared to 94.5% in September '24

items.statement: Equity raise of INR175.8 crores announced; INR91.08 crores received in September 2024, balance INR84.72 crores receivable by March 2026 on warrant conversion
items.quote: Further, the company strengthened its capital position by announcing an equity raise of INR175.8 crores out of which INR91.08 crores was received in September '24 and the balance INR84.72 crores is receivable by March 2026

name: Shri Keshav Cements And Infra Ltd

items.statement: Promoter holding reduced by 2-3% due to sale of shares for home construction within promoter group
items.quote: So, the main reason behind the same is the construction of the home within the promoter group, So, that is why some small 2-3% had been sold to the to the retail investors.

items.statement: Consolidated liquidity including mutual funds, fixed deposits and bank balances stands at Rs 235.35 crore at group level
items.quote: Consolidated liquidity (in the form of MF, FD, Bank balance) is Rs. 235.35 Crores at a group level.

items.statement: Acquired majority stake in Peaton Electrical Company Limited, now holding 60%
items.quote: Our acquisition of the majority stake in Peaton Electrical Company Limited marks a very transformative step in our expansion strategy.

items.statement: PECL secured Siemens license to manufacture and sell SIEPAN 8PU co-branded switchboards
items.quote: PECL has also secured a prestigious license from Siemens to manufacture and sell SIEPAN's 8PU co-branded switchboards.

items.statement: No challenges seen in receivables or cash flow management currently
items.quote: No, we don't see any challenges right now in receivables because the good part of it is that, as you can see from the budget also and as you can see from the last year budget also, government is quite focused right now on the energy segment in terms of the -- sector that is starting from the generation right up to the distribution part.

items.statement: Promoter pledge of ~81.7% will reduce by ~INR300 crore worth of shares upon Refex deal closure; further similar transactions planned to substantially reduce pledge further.
items.quote: And as you know, we have already signed and we have already deleveraged on the EV lease debt by about INR300 crores, that INR300 crores of deleverage will also mean that another INR300 crores of share pledge will get removed from us.

items.statement: Warrants round of INR540 crore done earlier this fiscal; INR140 crore received, balance INR400 crore expected by 31 Dec 2025.
items.quote: So, we have done one warrants round for INR540 crores out of which we have received INR140 crores and INR400 crores is remaining to be received before the end of the last date, I think, for wiring of that money is 31st December 2025.

items.statement: Total liquidity ~INR250 crore as of 31 Dec 2024, half of which is free cash; working capital limits access of INR350-400 crore.
items.quote: Right. So, the total liquidity in the books is about INR250 crores. And on the working capital, about INR350 crores to INR400 crores access to the limits is what we have.

items.statement: Promoters converted warrants worth INR 17 crores into equity in the current financial year, with the remaining 50% to be converted next year.
items.quote: Only promoters have converted about 17 crores worth of warrants into equity. And the reason I always explain, you see in the current stock exchange rules, if you are having acquisition of more than 5% on a basis, it triggers certain other rules. So we wanted to be very careful. That's why we want to divide into two financial years. So 50% conversion was done here and 50% will be done in the next f

items.statement: Management declined to comment on promoter stake sale
items.quote: I would not like to , the company would not like to comment on the promoter stake sale where you are running the business on a day-to-day basis as part of management, and whatever questions you have on the company, happy to answer, but on promoter stake sale, unfortunately I would not be able to comment.

items.statement: Board deliberated on fundraising options; definitive disclosure expected by end of month
items.quote: We outlined it in the outcome of the Board meeting as well yesterday that the Board deliberated on the options that were put in front of the Board. So, we're very hopeful that by the end of this month, there will be something definitive that we can disclose to all investors through an exchange filing.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow due to long aquaculture cycle, processing, extended transit and credit periods
items.quote: Because that's since we are on aquaculture company, when we if we are growing more of our Shrimps, the culture period itself is 120 to 150 days. Then the processing will take one month. Then the export transit period is taking now the transit period because of all this rent fee issue and all from 40 days is gone to 60 days.

items.statement: Factoring arrangement planned to get cash immediately after shipment
items.quote: So definitely, now we are working on some factoring where the once we go for a factoring arrangement, we will get the cash immediately after shipment, but maybe the factoring company will collect from the customer at a later date.

items.statement: NCD outstanding approximately INR 16.45 crores redeemable over next four years
items.quote: It is approximately INR 16.45 crores outstanding NCDs upon date.

items.statement: Cash balance of INR 64 crore as of December 2024 invested in treasury, fixed deposits and mutual funds
items.quote: we have strong cash position of INR 64 crores which has been invested in treasury functions and fixed deposits and mutual funds.

items.statement: Trade receivables decreased from INR 77 crore in H1 to INR 55 crore as of December 2024
items.quote: The current receivable that we have is about INR55 crore. So whatever was billed in Q2, we've realized it.

items.statement: Net working capital at 140 days due to government managed services contracts
items.quote: our net working capital in terms of number of days is about 140 days.

items.statement: Kaizen Logistics acquisition almost completed; new company due diligence ongoing, expected to close in March if auditors clear it
items.quote: Kaizen Logistics transaction is already almost completed. And the new company due diligence is going on, so we need clearance from them, we can go ahead to buy this company.

items.statement: Acquiring 99% of target companies, retaining 1% for incumbent management sentiment
items.quote: Sir, 99% of the company we are acquiring , 1% because we have some sentiment with the company, so we are giving them only 1%.

items.statement: Promoters committed to business and will infuse equity if required, but prefer funding growth from internal cash flows
items.quote: We are totally committed to the business, if the business requires us to pump in more equity. We are - our endeavor right now is to sort of fuel our growth from the cash flows that we generate.

items.statement: Promoter sold negligible stake; proceeds reinvested in group companies
items.quote: we have sold a fractional, very negligible shareholding. Two thing that if you all recall that we were supposed to dilute our stake by selling to LT1, and it did not happen because of their inability to fulfill the agreement.
